system.description: Base Essence (Elemental Companion) 5.7.2 - Wind Mastery. Not needing to breathe, levitating and flying (up to Fly True at 450'/round), stabilizing against wind effects, cross winds that foul missile fire, repulsing/shearing winds that push and ground fliers, a wind tunnel trap, turning the caster's body to gas, summoning a wind storm, and ultimately a devastating Tornado. Note: as printed, the source's own descriptions reference a 'Fly II' and a 'Cross Winds III' that don't actually appear as their own table entries/rows - kept verbatim rather than inventing missing spell data for them.
Target's lungs do not need to breathe for the duration. Target is unaffected by gasses or liquids that might otherwise harm them (i.e. drowning etc.)
Allows target to move up and down vertically 10' per round. It does not confer the ability to move horizontally; that must be achieved through other means.
Caster forces the air in the area to move quickly in one direction. This will cause gasses to clear and will give a -20 to all missile attacks in the area.
Target can fly at a rate of 75' per round (approximately 5mph.) While Fly is active, normal movement (e.g. walking, running, etc.) is not allowed.
Target's personal effects are made resistant to the effects of wind. Attacks and maneuvers by target have the penalties caused by wind or wind based spells, reduced by 50.
Causes all missile attacks in the area to be blown off course, giving them a -50 attack modification.
As Stabilize, except it affects all within a 10' radius.

Caster causes severe winds to blow in a single direction (chosen at moment of casting). Movement is reduced in one direction by 50 ft per round by the sheer force of winds in the area. Movement is increased by 50 ft per round in opposite direction. An Easy Moving maneuver must be made each round or suffer those who fail suffer an 'A' Unbalancing critical. Missile attacks are impossible in the area of effect. Caster is not immune to the effects of the winds (it is centered on caster).
As Cross Winds I, except missile attacks have a -100 attack modifier.

Aerial target is forced down 20 ft per 10% failure. If target impacts with a solid object target takes a Fall Attack equal to the distance forced down. Otherwise they must make a Hard Flying maneuver or spin out of control, effects of which are up to the GM. If cast on a target on the ground, they must resist or take a 'C' Unbalancing critical.
As Fly I, except target moves at 300' per round.
As Fly I, except one target per level is affected.

Target must make a Resistance Roll or they are confined within a tunnel of wind. Any attempts to go through the tunnel gives target an 'A' Impact crit and an 'A' Unbalancing critical (roll separately). If either results in a stun result then target is pushed back into the center of the wind tunnel. Attacks through the tunnel are modified by -150.

Target's body turns into a gaseous state. While in this form no physical action may be accomplished other than movement (i.e. they can't attack, grasp objects, etc.). Target may still be targeted by spells and can be hit only by magic weapons. Target can move through any object that air can move through. Target can also cast spells in this form, except all Elemental (E) class spells automatically fail. If target is hit by a Vacuum spell, the attack delivers a Slaying critical.
Caster calls forth a wind storm with the maximum wind speeds equal to twice his level, and an intensity according to his desires. Effects will vary according to circumstance (and GM's discretion).
As Sheering Winds I, except target is forced down 30 ft per 10% failure.
As Fly I, except target moves 450' per round.
As Fly II, except it affects one target per level of the caster.
As Cross Winds I, except missile attacks have a -200 attack modifier.
As Fly III, except for duration.
As Repulsing Winds, except movement is enhanced/restricted by 100' per round. Those failing the Easy maneuver must take a 'B' Unbalancing critical.
As Sheering Winds I, except target is forced down 50' per 10% failure.

Caster summons a 100' tall tornado with a 30' radius base, which takes one round to form. Tornado is sent the following round in a single direction, traveling 50' in 3 seconds. Those in the path take a +75 Medium Bash attack from debris and must make a resistance roll or be thrown a number of feet equal to the amount by which they failed. Targets who are thrown take a Fall/Krush attack that has a bonus equal to half of the feet they are thrown. If cast over water, it becomes a water spout; bash attack is +50 and failing a resistance roll will only throw the target a number of feet equal to one quarter of their resistance roll failure. If this spell cannot achieve full height then it fails (e.g., a 30' ceiling will disrupt the spell's energy causing the funnel cloud to fail).
